story: Pip spends his quiet days decorating his little room as autumn dusk settles outside. He learns by doing, crafting things with his own hands even when his first tries are clumsy. Changing things helped him feel better, though moving things around often made him feel worse. He stayed deeply focused on his tasks throughout the day, doing and searching the web. He still needs to build his wooden birdhouse. At dusk, he returns to the autumn window. Late at night, he sits down by candlelight to write in his diary.

opened.text:
Ville du Havre (French: [vil dy avʁ]) was a French iron steamship that operated round trips between the northern coast of France and New York City.
